node.statement: Let X=U bold-dot V and D=L_X-A. For every Y, the associator axiom gives ||D(Y)||=||(U bold-dot V) bold-dot Y-U bold-dot(V bold-dot Y)||<=epsilon_r||U||||V||||Y||<=4epsilon_r||Y||, so ||A^{-1}D||<=36epsilon_r<=9/16<1. The Neumann series sum_{n>=0}(-A^{-1}D)^n converges in the finite-dimensional operator algebra and is the two-sided inverse of I+A^{-1}D. Hence L_X=A(I+A^{-1}D) is invertible. Taking R=L_X^{-1}(J) yields X bold-dot R=J, so X has a right inverse.
